reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration for managing Git provider credentials and accessing repository, file, issue, and pull-request data across GitLab, GitHub, Gitee, Gitea, and Bitbucket.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 GitLab、GitHub、Gitee、Gitea 和 Bitbucket 凭据，并通过工具访问仓库、文件、议题和拉取请求数据。
summaries.en: Manages GitLab, GitHub, Gitee, Gitea, and Bitbucket credentials in DeepSeek Harness and provides tools for accessing repositories, files, issues, and pull requests.

capabilities: Stores Git provider API tokens in an encrypted local store
Provides a web settings panel for managing provider sites and tokens
Makes authenticated API requests to GitLab, GitHub, Gitee, Gitea, and Bitbucket
Reads repositories, files, issues, and pull requests through registered tools
